id: title:adboio:track intent prompt flag on tool calls

review.posthog_relevance: Adds telemetry and property recording for the `$mcp_tool_call` event, specifically capturing the evaluated state of the `MCP_INTENT_PROMPT_FLAG` feature flag. This supports downstream analytics and potential feature-flag-dependent behavior.
review.reason: The chunk contains implementation and configuration changes, not just documentation. P1.F2.H2 adds the property `$feature/${MCP_INTENT_PROMPT_FLAG}` to the captured properties of `$mcp_tool_call`, and P1.F2.H1 imports the necessary constant. P1.F1.H1 documents this behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based on the presence of implementation and configuration changes. However, the actual benefit or downstream usage of this telemetry is not demonstrated in the provided observations. The tier is conservative, acknowledging the implementation while not claiming broader systemic impact or unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. No implementation or configuration changes are supplied, so no score can be assigned.
